answers.explanation: Impulse has dimensions force × time, M L T^-1, the same as momentum.
The horizontal velocity component is 18 cos 60° = 9 m/s.
The eastward component is 10 cos 60° = 5 N, so 5 N westward cancels it.
Free-fall time depends on height and gravitational acceleration, not mass; both take 5 s.
If the ball stops at the wall, impulse = mv = 0.15 × 50 = 7.5 N s.
Gravitational force varies inversely as distance squared; reducing distance threefold increases force ninefold to 9.0 × 10^-4 N.
For constant force, a = F/m; acceleration varies inversely with m and directly with 1/m. Graphs III and IV fit.
The weight's moment is 0.5 × 20 = 10 N cm; a 2 N force balances it at 5 cm.
At terminal velocity, upward viscous drag plus upthrust balances the weight.
Velocity ratio = 40/8 = 5; efficiency 0.8 gives mechanical advantage 4, so effort = 100/4 = 25 N.
Strain = extension/length = 2.0 × 10^-5/0.01 = 2 × 10^-3.
Liquid pressure acts in all directions, increases with depth, and at equal depths is proportional to density: I, II and IV.
Upthrust is proportional to density; in water it is 0.210/0.875 = 0.240 N.
Resistance varies linearly: (6 − 3)/(8 − 3) × 100 = 60°C.
At constant pressure V/T is constant: T2 = 300 × 120/100 = 360 K = 87°C.
Melting needs 0.042 × 3.4 × 10^5 = 14280 J; cooling water by 17°C supplies this from 0.20 kg, or 200 g.
Saturated vapour is in dynamic equilibrium with its liquid: evaporation and condensation rates are equal.
The kinetic theory assumes gas molecules are identical and very small compared with the container.
Sound waves exhibit reflection and diffraction; sound in air is longitudinal and cannot be polarized.
v is proportional to √T: v2 = 360√(400/300) = 240√3 m/s.
A closed organ pipe has a displacement antinode at its open end.
For the fundamental, λ = 2L; v = fλ = 200 × 1.0 = 200 m/s.
The third overtone is the fourth harmonic: 4 × 280 = 1120 Hz.
An object inside the focal length of a concave mirror forms a virtual, erect, magnified image.
A parabolic mirror sends rays from its focus out as a parallel beam, suitable for a searchlight.
Apparent displacement through a glass block is d = t(1 − 1/n).
For a convex lens of focal length 30 cm to form a virtual image at 25 cm, the object distance is 150 cm.
Infra-red is invisible, called heat radiation, and transverse; its frequency is lower than blue light. I, II and IV are true.
Ebonite rubbed with fur becomes negative and glass rubbed with silk becomes positive; opposite charges attract.
Pure zinc as the negative pole reduces local action by minimizing impurities that form local cells.
The right branch is 2 + 2 + 2 = 6 Ω; 6 Ω parallel with 3 Ω gives 2 Ω, plus the two 1 Ω series resistors = 4 Ω.
Work done W = QV = 2 × 100 = 200 J.
Laminating the iron core reduces eddy currents and the energy they dissipate.
Heat dissipated = I²Rt = 100² × 0.5 × 3600 = 1.8 × 10^7 J.
At resonance f = 1/(2π√LC); for 8 mH and 5 μF this is 2500/π Hz.
Efficiency = VsIs/(VpIp), so Ip = (8 × 15)/(0.80 × 240) = 0.625 A.
320 days is four half-lives; remaining atoms = 6.0 × 10^10/16 = 3.75 × 10^9.
Photoelectric emission occurs when each photon has energy greater than the metal's work function.
